A feast for the eyes and a surprise for the tongue.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Spinach|Spinach]]
* [[Cookbook:Lemon|Lemon]] or [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Sumak|Sumak]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==

# Clean the spinach leaves and remove stems.
# [[Cookbook:Blanching|Blanch]] leaves in boiling water for 2–3 minutes.
# Rinse in cold water.
# Wash lemon thoroughly.
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] lemon paper-thin with sharp knife.
# Arrange plate circularly: loosely place a small bunch of leaves, then a slice of lemon, and so on.
# Sprinkle with coarse ground black pepper, salt, and sumak.
